text: Sorry it's so late. I'm the grandad, looking after our little one who's 4. He's got a temperature of 39.4. He was sick once earlier this evening but I think he's kept his drinks down since, he's had a beaker of water and some juice and they've stayed put. Also he hasn't done a poo in three days which is making him a bit grumpy, I don't know if that's related. He's weeing normally though, that seems fine. I'm worn out to be honest, just not sure if I should be doing something different.
